grafias_do_espelho: Source: Hall, Journal of Limnology, 2013; Scher et al., Nature, 2015
NUNCA 45 E 33.5 COMO UM TEMPO SÓ
texto_aprovado: Around 45 million years ago, Australia started moving north, and over the millions of years that followed, deep ocean opened up behind it. Follow it up the map: a whole continent on the move, with water on every side. For tens of millions of years, it traveled alone. You might assume nothing new could reach it until it ran into something. But before Australia ever reached Asia, something had already made the crossing.
